title: 第13章 抱有成见第14章 燃料
slug: 从一证永证开始成神第432章
content_zh:
;;
夜色压下时，北炉像张开血盆口。
火光把阴影逼开，空气辣得能割人。炉前的雪早被烤成水，又被冷风冻回一层薄硬的灰壳，踩上去咯吱作响。
叶霄站在燃炉三尺处。
那是连老工都不愿久站的位置……离炉口越近，瘴气越重，灼风越狠，稍一失神，热浪就能把人逼得眩晕；脚下一软，整个人就会往下跌。
老工不是站不了，只是站不久，也不值得。顶炉不按距离给钱，多靠一步，不过是多掉一层皮。
高温烫皮，瘴气钻鼻入喉，冷热来回撕扯，先烤一遍，再浸一遍，骨头都被翻出来受罪。
叶霄纹丝不动。
脚掌扎进粗糙石面，脚趾扣住微微翘起的边角；膝微曲，腰背绷成一条干净的线。呼吸按着桩功的节拍一沉一提，赤血桩落下去，他整个人连同脚下的石面，都被压死在炉前。
汗水从下颌滴落，还没真正落地，“嗤”地一声化作白气，一缕缕从脚边冒起。
工人们看得发麻。
“一整天都站在那，他到底是怎么做到的？”
“而且……他是不是又往炉口挪了？”
“疯了吧？顶炉不是这么顶的，今天都还没休息，想赚钱也不是这样想。”
没人敢靠近他，只能远远议论。
只有叶霄自己知道……钱只是表面，他真正目的是把这条命锻得更硬。
刀要更快，就得磨得更狠。
他已没有退路。
今早刚来时，他告诉工头：接下来几天，他都要待在北炉。
工头盯了他半晌，眼神分明把他当疯子，最后只丢下一句：“别摔下去，那会害到我。”

北炉要命。
可对叶霄而言，它也是最快的路：快，意味着更早把命握在手里；慢，意味着被人踩死。
视野角落，命格光字一闪而逝。
【赤血桩·小成：320／600】
叶霄胸口那口气并没变轻，反倒更沉。
赤血桩的‘沉’不是把人压趴，而是把散开的力一寸寸收回。皮肉被烫得收紧，筋肉在更深处绞住，把原本乱窜的劲硬压成一股力。
抬手时不再虚飘，整条手臂贴实了重量，猛劲没涨，稳劲先沉了下去。
疼痛没有减少，反而更狠。
皮下灼热反复碾过，骨头里的寒意刚被挤出去，又被瘴气倒灌回来。他不分心去看进步，只把每一寸痛都往骨里压。
越痛，越稳。
越痛，越清醒地知道：自己还活着。
……
张屠死后的第二天，哑巷没乱。
天一亮来了人，也是青枭帮的，袖口带黑线，却没张屠那样横。
他不骂人、不打人，也不敲竹板，只把巷钱一户户收齐，低头在册子上勾一笔，转身就走，连眼皮都懒得抬。
巷口没人被当街踹翻，也没有人被点名羞辱。
门缝后、墙根下，那些攥紧的手这才慢慢松开，指节的白一点点退下去。
可那点松动还没落稳，他们就明白：张屠死了，巷子还会继续吞人。
换了收钱的人，规矩还在。
而叶霄并不知道这些。

When the night falls, Beiliu opens its mouth like a bloody bowl.
The firelight forced the shadows away, and the air was so spicy it could cut you. The snow in front of the stove had already been baked into water, and was frozen back into a thin hard ash shell by the cold wind, making it creak when stepped on.
Ye Xiao stood three feet away from the stove.
That's a position where even old workers don't want to stand for a long time... The closer you are to the furnace mouth, the heavier the miasma and the fiercer the scorching wind. If you lose your concentration for a moment, the heat wave can make you dizzy; if your feet weaken, your whole person will fall.
It’s not that the veteran worker can’t stand, it’s just that it’s not worth it if he doesn’t stand for a long time. The top stove does not pay according to the distance. An extra step is just an extra layer of skin.
The skin is scalded at high temperatures, the miasma enters the nose and throat, the cold and heat are torn back and forth, first roasted, then soaked, the bones are turned out and tortured.
Ye Xiao remained motionless.
The soles of the feet were dug into the rough stone surface, and the toes were clasped on the slightly raised corners; the knees were slightly bent, and the waist and back were stretched into a clean line. His breathing rose and fell according to the rhythm of the pile work. The red blood pile fell, and his whole body and the stone surface under his feet were crushed to death in front of the furnace.
Sweat dripped from his chin, and before it really hit the ground, it turned into white air with a "chi" sound, and wisps of it emerged from his feet.
The workers were stunned.
"Standing there all day, how the hell did he do that?"
"And...did he move to the stove again?"
"Are you crazy? That's not how the stove is built. I haven't even had a day off today, and that's not what I want to do if I want to make money."
No one dared to get close to him and could only discuss it from a distance.
Only Ye Xiao himself knows...money is just superficial, his real purpose is to make this life stronger.
To make a knife faster, it must be sharpened harder.
There was no way out for him.
When he first arrived this morning, he told the foreman that he would stay in Beiluo for the next few days.
The foreman stared at him for a long time, his eyes clearly treating him as a madman, and in the end he just said: "Don't fall, it will hurt me."
Bei Lu is fatal.
But for Ye Xiao, it is also the fastest way: fast means taking his life in his hands earlier; slow means being trampled to death.
In the corner of his field of vision, the words of destiny flashed away.
[Red Blood Stake·Small Success: 320/600]
The breath in Ye Xiao's chest did not become lighter, but instead became heavier.
The 'sunkenness' of the red blood pile does not crush the person, but retracts the scattered force inch by inch. The skin and flesh were tightened by the heat, and the muscles were twisted deeper, compressing the originally chaotic energy into one force.
When I raised my hand, I no longer floated in vain. The whole arm was firmly attached to the weight. The strong strength did not increase, but the steady strength sank first.
The pain didn't lessen, but got worse.
The burning heat under the skin was repeatedly crushed, and the chill in the bones was squeezed out, only to be poured back by the miasma. He wasn't distracted to see the progress, he just pressed every inch of pain into his bones.
The more painful it is, the more stable it is.
The more painful it is, the more clearly I know: I am still alive.
…
The day after Zhang Tu's death, there was no chaos in Mute Alley.
At dawn someone came, and he was also from the Qing Xiao Gang. His sleeves had black lines, but they were not as bold as Zhang Tu.
He didn't curse or hit anyone, nor did he knock bamboo boards. He just collected all the money from each household, lowered his head and made a check in the book, turned around and left without even raising his eyelids.
No one was kicked down in the street, and no one was named and shamed.
Behind the crack of the door and under the wall, the clenched hands slowly loosened, and the whiteness of the knuckles receded little by little.
But before that loosened up, they understood: Zhang Tu was dead, and the alley would continue to swallow people.
The person collecting money has changed, but the rules are still there.
But Ye Xiao didn't know this.
